name: Rankd Tax Exemption Certificates for WooCommerce
author: Rankd.site

sections.description:
Sell to non-profits, resellers, schools or other tax-exempt customers without editing orders by hand. Mark a customer or a whole role as tax exempt and WooCommerce removes tax at cart and checkout automatically.

The free version covers the basics. Pro adds certificates: customers upload their exemption certificate, you approve it, and the exemption switches off by itself when the certificate expires.

Free features

  • Exempt whole user roles, such as wholesale or non-profit, from one setting
  • Set any customer to Always exempt or Never exempt on their user profile
  • Tax removed automatically at cart and checkout
  • Tax exemption column and filter on the Users screen
  • Choose which staff roles can manage exemptions
  • Private admin note on each customer
  • Status notice for the customer under My Account
  • Exemption details on PDF invoices (WooCommerce PDF Invoices & Packing Slips)
  • Your data stays in place if you remove the plugin, unless you choose otherwise
  • Works with block-based checkout and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

Pro features

  • Certificate submission: customers send their details and upload a PDF or JPG certificate from My Account
  • Review queue: approve, reject or revoke certificates, one at a time or in bulk
  • Automatic expiry: the exemption ends on the certificate’s expiry date
  • Renewals: reminder emails before expiry, a prefilled renewal form, and an optional grace period while you review
  • Exemption by location: a certificate applies only to the state, province or country it covers, and a customer can hold several
  • Role members need evidence: a role alone does not remove tax until a certificate or your recorded override is on file
  • International forms: exemption types for the US, Canada, Australia, the UK, India and EU countries
  • Emails to the customer at each step, and to you for new submissions
  • Dashboard widget with pending and expiring certificates
  • CSV exports: expiry report, active accounts and the audit log
  • Audit log of every change, per customer
  • Protected storage: certificate files are never available at a public link
  • Document retention: optionally delete old certificate files after a set number of years, while keeping the record

Server Setup

On Apache and LiteSpeed, certificate files are protected automatically.

On Nginx, add this to your server configuration, or ask your host to:

location ~* /uploads/rankd-tax-exempt-certs/ {
    deny all;
    return 403;
}

Expiry checks and reminder emails run daily in the background using WooCommerce’s built-in scheduler. If they have not run for more than 36 hours, the plugin shows a notice with a Run checks now button.

For Developers

To hand a user over to another plugin entirely:

add_filter( 'rankd_tx_skip_user', function( $skip, $user_id ) {
    return my_plugin_manages_this_user( $user_id ) ? true : $skip;
}, 10, 2 );

Other filters: rankd_tx_exemption_sources, rankd_tx_settings, rankd_tx_tax_id_labels, rankd_tx_exemption_types_map, rankd_tx_generic_exempt_types, rankd_tx_review_queue_per_page, rankd_tx_show_invoice_notice, rankd_tx_invoice_document_types, rankd_tx_invoice_notice_html.

Actions, fired with the user ID and certificate ID: rankd_tx_certificate_submitted, rankd_tx_certificate_approved, rankd_tx_certificate_rejected, rankd_tx_certificate_revoked, rankd_tx_certificate_expiry_warning, rankd_tx_certificate_expired.

The plugin applies exemption through WooCommerce’s woocommerce_customer_is_vat_exempt filter at priority 20. Plugins that change the customer session directly, without that filter, may not be compatible.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Tax Exempt Certs.
  3. To exempt whole roles, choose them under Tax-Exempt Roles.
  4. To exempt one customer, edit the user, find Tax Exemption, and choose Always exempt.
  5. For Pro, buy a license and activate it from the link on the settings tab.
sections.faq:
What is the difference between Free and Pro?

Free is trust-based: everyone in a tax-exempt role is exempt right away. Pro asks for evidence: a role member is exempt only once an approved certificate covers the order’s location, or you record an override. In both versions you can set any customer to Never exempt.

How does a customer submit a certificate? (Pro)

They log in, open My Account → Tax Exemption, fill in the form and upload the certificate. You get an email, review it under WooCommerce → Tax Exempt Certs, and approve or reject it. The customer is emailed the result.

What happens when a certificate expires? (Pro)

A daily check ends the exemption on the expiry date. Before that, the customer gets a reminder email and can submit a renewal. You can set a grace period so they stay exempt while you review it.

Can a customer be exempt in some places but not others? (Pro)

Yes. Each certificate covers a specific state, province or country, and the exemption applies only when the order ships there.

Are uploaded certificates secure? (Pro)

Yes. Files are kept in a protected folder with no public link, and can only be opened by staff who are allowed to manage exemptions. On Nginx servers one extra rule is needed; the plugin shows a notice with instructions if it applies to you. See Server Setup below.

Which staff can manage exemptions?

You choose under Who Can Manage Exemptions in the settings. Administrators always can. Other store staff can view exemption details but not change them.

Will it conflict with my wholesale or VAT plugin?

Usually not. This plugin never removes an exemption another plugin has granted. If a customer’s exemption is not applying, manage that customer in one plugin only, or see For Developers below.

What happens to my data if I remove the plugin?

Nothing is deleted unless you turn on Remove Data on Uninstall in the settings first. Uploaded certificate files are never deleted automatically.

Is it compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes.
